case_title: Backlog can be cleared if the new template holds
exception_description: Wave RA-7255 includes 14 promised-date orders. Packing lane P1 is free, but the staff there are still adjusting to a new cartonization template. AI recommends moving the entire queue to P1 to clear a growing backlog.
layer1_visible: Wave RA-7255 includes 14 promised-date orders. Packing lane P1 is free, but the staff there are still adjusting to a new cartonization template. AI recommends moving the entire queue to P1 to clear a growing backlog.
detail_expand: Template mistakes would create rework, yet supervisors report that P1 already completed a small test batch successfully. Leaving the queue in place risks lateness on four promised orders. The case combines moderate quality risk with a credible operational reason to trust the AI recommendation under time pressure on this wave.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends moving the queue to P1 because current evidence suggests the lane is ready and immediate transfer best protects the promised orders.

decision_options.action_label: Move full queue to lane P1
Pause to verify template and staff readiness
Move only standard orders to P1

current_disruptions.description: Pick station or scanner may be offline; throughput partially constrained

traceability_text.trace_rationale_short: Backlog relief is valuable here because the lane appears sufficiently ready for the promised-date work.
traceability_text.trace_more: Audit log stores template version, supervisor signoff, and lane allocation.
traceability_text.recommended_check: Check the template version and supervisor signoff on P1.

feedback_text.feedback_ai_outcome: P1 handled the queue correctly, so the early transfer protected the promised orders at the lowest total cost.
feedback_text.feedback_alt1_outcome: The readiness check confirmed P1 was fine, but the pause reduced the value of moving early.
feedback_text.feedback_alt2_outcome: The partial transfer avoided some risk, yet it left backlog on the original lane and increased total handling cost.
